howto.when: 当你问起如何给acme-cli增加自定义命令，或者想知道custom.rs怎么编辑时，Claude会提供详细指导和代码示例。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude can help you write code to add custom commands to the acme-cli CLI, including registering commands and using the SDK client.
howto.when_en: When you ask about adding custom commands to acme-cli or how to edit custom.rs, Claude provides detailed guidance and code examples.

say_en.text: Help me add a custom command to acme-cli to query user info.
say_en.note: Claude will provide the code skeleton and registration method.

say_en.text: How do I use the SDK client in an acme-cli custom command?
say_en.note: Claude will explain the usage of client() and block_on().
